Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the specific educational information requested by the Planner. Although the search results page clearly displayed a Wikipedia snippet containing the exact answer ("Burroughs attended Harvard University..."), the agent's report only listed the URL and generic interface text (e.g., "Upgrade to our browser") without quoting or summarizing the visible content. This failure to extract the available data forced the Planner to issue redundant instructions to "open and extract" information that was already visible on the screen, leading to a cycle of ineffective searching.
